requires.schemas: ../../schemas + ../../vocab (walk-up discovery; AUTHORITY_SCHEMA_DIR/AUTHORITY_VOCAB_DIR to override when vendored)

tools.name: authority-init
tools.description: Scaffold a new registry for a topic area.

tools.name: authority-add
tools.description: Add a skeleton source profile (born asserted; first polite probe by default).

tools.name: authority-validate
tools.description: Run the conformance rule engine; reports level and operational_here. Read-only.

tools.name: authority-probe
tools.description: Verify access claims with polite live checks; appends evidence-backed probe records. Network: HEAD/GET + robots.txt per method.

tools.name: authority-fetch
tools.description: Execute a profiled endpoint with credential injection; writes payload + UPC-compatible sidecar. Network: the profiled request(s), budget- and robots-respecting.

tools.name: authority-creds
tools.description: Manage credential references (values via hidden stdin to gitignored file 0600, or macOS Keychain; never printed).

tools.name: authority-regen
tools.description: Rebuild derived state, manifest, CSV mirror, and HTML browser atomically. Also the crash-recovery move.

tools.name: authority-export
tools.description: Emit consumer projections (pi-forge registries, markdown, CSV).

tools.name: authority-build-index
tools.description: Generate the self-contained offline HTML browser. Read-only over profiles.

tools.name: authority-mint
tools.description: Compute a content-addressed id by the spec/06 recipes.
